README.md.note: What each file does and where to install the folder. Start here.

config.php.note: Title, description, palette tab, modal size, and `title_template` — the live label on the builder canvas. Note `{{- }}` (escaped) for user text vs `{{= }}` (raw).

options.php.note: The edit-modal fields. Each option id (`heading`, `text`, `align`) becomes a key in `$atts`. This array's shape IS the element's schema.

views/view.php.note: Front-end template. `$atts` holds the resolved values; escape everything with `esc_html()` / `esc_attr()`.

static.php.note: Enqueues the CSS + JS, only when the element is on the page. Uses `get_declared_URI()` so theme overrides win.

static/css/my_element.css.note: Front-end styles, keyed off the `my-element--{align}` modifier class, plus the scroll-reveal states.

static/js/my_element.js.note: Reveals each box as it scrolls into view. Progressive enhancement: with no JS or reduced-motion the box stays visible.

static/img/page_builder.svg.note: The palette icon (required): a crisp 16x16 glyph, fixed fill `#b3b3b3`, integer coordinates.
